high_level_description: This image features a graphic design of a t-shirt displayed on a hanger against a dark green grid background. The t-shirt is predominantly light gray with a vibrant, abstract design printed on the front. The design consists of overlapping geometric shapes and blocks in a variety of colors, including blue, pink, yellow, orange, and red, creating a dynamic and modern aesthetic. The text "template by @bespatteredfacade" is prominently displayed twice on the image, once near the top right corner and again at the bottom center, indicating the creator or source of the template used for this design.
